name: What will I actually get from a bathroom vanity replacement?

mainEntity.name: What will I actually get from a bathroom vanity replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: A vanity replacement usually improves storage, updates the room’s look, and can make the sink area easier to clean and use. The final result depends on the quality of the cabinet, countertop, sink, and installation work. If your old vanity is warped, stained, or leaking, replacing it is often one of the most noticeable bathroom upgrades you can make.
acceptedAnswer.description: You should get better storage, a cleaner look, and a more functional sink area if the vanity is measured and installed correctly.
